content: अध्यवसायः .²1 An attempt, effort, exertion; न स्वल्पमप्यध्यवसायभीरोः करोति विज्ञाननिधिर्गुणं हि <ls>H. 1</ls>, <ab>v. l.</ab>; ˚सहचरेषु साहसेषु <ls>Dk. 161</ls>. .²2 Determination, resolution; mental effort or apprehension; संभावनं नाम अस्तित्वाध्यवसायः <ls>P. VI. 2. 21</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> also प्रतिविषयाध्यवसायो दृष्टम् . <ls>Sāṅ. K. 5</ls>. .²3 Perseverance, diligence, energy, constancy; तत्कोऽयं पदे पदे महाननध्यवसायः <ls>U. 4</ls> absence of energy or resolution, drooping of spirits; (with महानध्यवसायः as the reading, the meaning would be ‘why this effort on your part {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} to determine whether you should go or not, hesitation’.)
